item.title: Houthis seize port, US strikes five Iranian tankers, oil tops $100 as Middle East crisis deepens
item.description: The United States destroyed five Iranian oil tankers in the Gulf of Oman and near Iran's Kharg Island on Tuesday, Central Command announced, as oil prices surged past $100 a barrel amid escalating conflict across the Middle East. item.title: Ukraine strikes deep into Russia's Arctic gas heartland; Russian attacks kill 7 in Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian drones struck deep into Russia's Arctic north on Wednesday, sparking a fire at an industrial facility in Novy Urengoy, a city in the heart of Russia's most important natural-gas producing region, according to Russian officials and news agencies. item.title: Trump pledges $5,000 dividend if GOP wins midterms; Fetterman makes surprise video appearance at convention
item.description: This was the first Republican midterm convention ever held, an event organized at Trump's initiative to energize the party base amid polling that suggests the GOP could lose one or both chambers of Congress in November. item.title: Apple's foldable iPhone Duo becomes official; AirPods 5 and Watch Series 12 also debut
